caption: In an Indian village, the evening square is called the chaupal.
spoken: In an Indian village, the evening square is called the chow-paal.

caption: A lamp, a board, and someone across it.
spoken: A lamp, a board, and someone across it.

caption: For many elders now, the person across the board lives in another city.
spoken: For many elders now, the person across the board lives in another city.

caption: By 2050, India's share of people over sixty doubles, to 20.8 percent.
spoken: By twenty fifty, India's share of people over sixty doubles, to twenty point eight percent.

caption: And 66 percent of older people surveyed in ten cities find digital tools too confusing.
spoken: And sixty-six percent of older people surveyed in ten cities find digital tools too confusing.

caption: So we rebuilt the square as an app, and called it Chaupal.
spoken: So we rebuilt the square as an app, and called it chow-paal.

caption: She speaks Hindi. An agent writes, draws and plays with her, and her family joins at the same board.
spoken: She speaks Hindi. An agent writes, draws and plays with her, and her family joins at the same board.

caption: The live app, in two sessions: her tablet, and her grandson's phone.
spoken: The live app, in two sessions: her tablet, and her grandson's phone.

caption: She asks in Hindi: take his rook with the knight.
spoken: She asks in Hindi: take his rook with the knight.

caption: Her agent plays her words on the real board, and the move reaches his phone in a median of 3.94 seconds.
spoken: Her agent plays her words on the real board, and the move reaches his phone in a median of three point nine four seconds.

caption: He takes back with a pawn, and his move comes home the same way.
spoken: He takes back with a pawn, and his move comes home the same way.

caption: For Diwali, she wants to show him a greeting.
spoken: For Diwali, she wants to show him a greeting.

caption: Her agent puts the phrase on screen. HarfBuzz shapes the text, so every conjunct and vowel sign is exactly right.
spoken: Her agent puts the phrase on screen. Harf Buzz shapes the text, so every conjunct and vowel sign is exactly right.

caption: She traces it with her finger. Her lines stay on their own layer, and only hers can be erased.
spoken: She traces it with her finger. Her lines stay on their own layer, and only hers can be erased.

caption: For the doorstep, a rangoli. A generator draws it; the agent only sets the design.
spoken: For the doorstep, a rung-o-lee. A generator draws it; the agent only sets the design.

caption: She says: yellow in the middle, red outside. Exactly those regions fill.
spoken: She says: yellow in the middle, red outside. Exactly those regions fill.

caption: Say haan, and the picture reaches the family's Telegram.
spoken: Say hahn, and the picture reaches the family's Telegram.

caption: Say mat bhejo, and nothing leaves the house.
spoken: Say mutt bay-joe, and nothing leaves the house.

caption: And if Rahul moves first, the agent's stale move is refused, and she sees why.
spoken: And if Rahul moves first, the agent's stale move is refused, and she sees why.

caption: Underneath, it's one set of Agent-Native actions.
spoken: Underneath, it's one set of agent native actions.

caption: Her voice, her touch, Rahul's phone, Claude through an MCP App card, and Telegram all call the same defineAction.
spoken: Her voice, her touch, Rahul's phone, Claude through an M C P app card, and Telegram all call the same define action.

caption: Every write is checked against the board's revision in shared SQL, and live sync carries it to both screens.
spoken: Every write is checked against the board's revision in shared S Q L, and live sync carries it to both screens.

caption: Engines own the truth: HarfBuzz for text, a rangoli generator, chess.js for the rules.
spoken: Engines own the truth: Harfbuzz for text, a rangoli generator, chess J S for the rules.

caption: We measured it: 21 cases written in an elder's voice, 2 runs each.
spoken: We measured it: twenty-one cases written in an elder's voice, two runs each.

caption: The same model with only browser control passed 8 of 42. With the app's actions, 40 of 42.
spoken: The same model with only browser control passed eight of forty-two. With the app's actions, forty of forty-two.

caption: It does use more tokens per try: about 49,000, against 36,000.
spoken: It does use more tokens per try: about forty-nine thousand, against thirty-six thousand.

caption: And OCR reads 21 of 50 shaped phrases exactly, against 8 for unshaped text.
spoken: And O C R reads twenty-one of fifty shaped phrases exactly, against eight for unshaped text.

caption: One case still fails: before its Hindi reply, the agent sometimes writes an English aside.
spoken: One case still fails: before its Hindi reply, the agent sometimes writes an English aside.

caption: Her language, not an app's.
spoken: Her language, not an app's.

caption: Her family, at the same board.
spoken: Her family, at the same board.

caption: Nothing leaves without her say.
spoken: Nothing leaves without her say.

caption: And 40 of 42 where browser control alone managed 8.
spoken: And forty of forty-two where browser control alone managed eight.

caption: The square is open again, wherever the family is.
spoken: The square is open again, wherever the family is.
